name: word-roller-fade-slide
title: Word Roller Fade Slide
description: A left-aligned lead-in over a bold word that slides up from below as it fades in and drifts up as it leaves, with an accent underline that redraws on every word and a big faint counter on the right.
useWhen: An editorial, left-aligned statement where one word changes (faster, smarter, better) and each step is counted.
A title card that needs a calm slide-and-fade rhythm.
avoidWhen: The line should stay centred: use a centred roller such as word-roller-blur.
The counter makes no sense for the words: turn it off with the Counter variable.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas. The last one is where it settles.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the word in pixels. Wide text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Counter
variables.description: Show the large step counter on the right.

variables.label: Frames per word
variables.description: How long each word is shown, in 30 fps frames.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
